_comment: All alike . `uniform features` stamps every tree and boulder from one shape,
so every oak is the same oak -- the stamped-shapes step, written on purpose. `uniform landmass` keeps to
the landforms laid out on a plan or with none at all -- pyramids, pillars, the flat -- and nothing torn,
smooths what wear would break up, and holds the land the same however far it is crossed. It cannot mean one
biome or one creature: `only` already says that.
